description: Land Acquisition - Walagammulla, Polgahawela D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Handugala, Polgahawela D/S Division, Kurunegala District - Amended Ext. Gaz. No. 1861/36 dated 08.05.2014 Thimbirigasyaya D/S Division, Colombo District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, describing specific parcels of land to be acquired by the government for public purposes. It includes detailed land descriptions, lot numbers, claimant names, and extents, along with procedures for compensation claims. This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters without involving government personnel changes or structural reorganizations.
